item.title: Codex Skills: Folders, Install and Disable (2026)
item.description:
A Codex skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file. The file holds a name, a description and the steps for one job. Codex sees the name and description at the start, and reads the full steps only when a task matches. Put the skill in the right folder, and Codex finds it on its own or when you type $ and its name.

What is in a skill folder?

item.title: Claude Code Skills: How They Work, Where They Live and Memory
item.description:
Claude Code skills are folders that hold a SKILL.md file with instructions for one kind of task. Claude reads each skill’s name and description at the start of a session. It loads the full instructions only when the task matches, or when you type /skill-name. Skills do not store facts about your work. For that, use CLAUDE.md files, auto memory, or a memory plugin.

This guide covers where skills live, the fields you can set, how they load, and what they do with memory. The source is the Claude Code skills docs, checked on 10 November 2026.
